sobre.title: About Me
sobre.p1Html: I am a Senior Software Engineer passionate about building robust, scalable, and high-performance systems. With over a decade of experience, I have worked at startups, fintechs, and large companies in the Brazilian market.
sobre.p2Html: I currently work as a Senior Software Engineer at PicPay, one of Brazil's largest financial super apps. Previously I was Tech Lead at NAPP and Senior Software Engineer at Getnet Brasil.
sobre.p3Html: My main stack revolves around Go and Java, with strong expertise in microservices architecture, messaging, relational and non-relational databases, and modern DevOps and Cloud practices.

projetos.title: Personal Projects
projetos.raceHubDesc: Complete system for managing and displaying virtual racing results. Robust platform with driver data, championships and detailed statistics.
projetos.gripDesc: Official website of the Grip Racing team — a legend of Brazilian virtual motorsport since 2008. 311 drivers, 169 titles and 18 years of history presented on a modern and dynamic platform.
projetos.raceResultsDesc: Tool that transforms racing simulator logs into formatted results. Supports iRacing, Assetto Corsa, Automobilista, rFactor and more. 37 published releases.
